baseline_prompt_en: Editorial lifestyle photograph of one unmistakably adult woman in a compact, orderly apartment living room, quietly placing a folded cream throw on the open middle shelf of a low oak bookcase after tidying. Her visible appearance takes loose guidance from the supplied portrait: long dark softly waved hair with a near-center part and a calm face. She stands close to the bookcase with both feet on the wood floor; her left palm supports the folded throw from below while her right fingertips guide its front edge onto the shelf. The bookcase has neat rows of books with a clear space for the throw. A pale sofa with two squared cushions occupies the right side of the room. A pleated table lamp stands on a sideboard behind the sofa, a closed paperback rests on a small round side table, and a woven storage basket sits under the bookcase. Small herbs in terracotta pots line the window sill beside sheer curtains. A medium-wide, eye-level composition keeps her hands, the shelf, the sofa, and the household objects readable in one natural frame; late-afternoon window light reveals oak grain, linen folds, and a quiet, recently tidied atmosphere.
